PassControl scanner sounds
==========================

Active sounds folder:
C:\Users\user\Desktop\project\data\sounds

Allowed pass sound file names, by priority:
- scan_allowed.wav
- allowed.wav
- ok.wav
- _default_scan_allowed.wav

Denied pass sound file names, by priority:
- Звук_неправильного_ответа_сто_к_одному.wav
- scan_denied.wav
- denied.wav
- fail.wav
- _default_scan_denied.wav

Important:
- Use real WAV files with PCM audio.
- MP3 files are supported on Windows.
- You can choose uploaded sounds in Settings.
- If the app is installed to C:\PassControl, replace files in C:\PassControl\data\sounds.
- If you run dist\PassControl\PassControl.exe, replace files in dist\PassControl\data\sounds.
